statement: Whenever check_x_matrix returns a result r, r = true if and only if both of the following hold: (1) for every i with 0 <= i < n, grid[i][i] != 0 and grid[i][n-1-i] != 0; (2) for every i, j with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n, if i != j and i + j != n - 1, then grid[i][j] = 0. Equivalently, r = false exactly when at least one of these two conditions fails.
preconditions: Let n = len(grid). The preconditions are: 3 <= n <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(grid[i]) = n; and for every i, j with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100000.

statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, check_x_matrix returns a result r; it does not fail (no overflow, out-of-bounds access, or panic).
preconditions: Let n = len(grid). The preconditions are: 3 <= n <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(grid[i]) = n; and for every i, j with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100000.

statement: Whenever check_x_matrix returns true, the number of pairs (i, j) with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= j < n, and grid[i][j] != 0 is 2*n - 1 if n is odd, and 2*n if n is even.
preconditions: Let n = len(grid). The preconditions are: 3 <= n <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(grid[i]) = n; and for every i, j with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100000.

statement: Whenever check_x_matrix returns true, for every row index i with 0 <= i < n, the number of columns j with 0 <= j < n and grid[i][j] != 0 is 1 if i = n - 1 - i, and is 2 otherwise.
preconditions: Let n = len(grid). The preconditions are: 3 <= n <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(grid[i]) = n; and for every i, j with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100000.

statement: Whenever check_x_matrix returns true, for every column index j with 0 <= j < n, the number of rows i with 0 <= i < n and grid[i][j] != 0 is 1 if j = n - 1 - j, and is 2 otherwise.
preconditions: Let n = len(grid). The preconditions are: 3 <= n <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(grid[i]) = n; and for every i, j with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100000.

statement: Whenever check_x_matrix(grid) returns r1 and check_x_matrix(grid2) returns r2, r1 = r2.
preconditions: Let n = len(grid) = len(grid2). The preconditions are: 3 <= n <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(grid[i]) = n and len(grid2[i]) = n; for every i, j with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n, 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 100000 and 0 <= grid2[i][j] <= 100000; and grid2 is the transpose of grid: for every i, j with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n, grid2[i][j] = grid[j][i].
